checks.requirement: Complete Dust II layout, scale, spawns, A/B sites, tunnels, mid, catwalk, long and pit against the pinned CS:GO map
Original map materials, props, lighting and sky compared at fixed reference camera positions
Collision, stairs, slopes, clipping and visibility tested across all map routes
Walking, running, crouching, jumping, acceleration, air movement and landing match measured reference behavior
Every weapon and equipment item in the agreed competitive loadout is usable, with correct team restrictions
Original weapon materials, hands, draw, reload, firing and inspection animations are bound correctly
Damage, armor, hitgroups, range falloff and penetration match reference test fixtures
Recoil, spread, movement inaccuracy, fire modes, scopes, magazines and reload timings match reference fixtures
HE, flash, smoke, decoy, Molotov and incendiary physics, effects and interactions match the agreed build
Carry, drop, pickup, plant, cancellation, defuse, kit timing, explosion and post-plant win conditions
5v5 team assignment, freeze time, round clock, round wins, halftime, match end and agreed overtime rules
Buy zones, buy time, money caps, prices, rewards, loss bonus, saving, drops and pickups match reference rules
Bots navigate the full map, perceive only valid information, use equipment, plant, defuse and complete matches
Original weapon, reload, surface-dependent footstep, grenade, bomb, radio and round audio mapped with positional attenuation
Radar, team state, health, armor, ammunition, inventory, timer, scoreboard and kill feed update correctly
Death, spectator switching, round restart and match restart work without stale state
Agreed ten-human networking scope, authority, synchronization, reconnect and latency behavior are implemented and tested
Full-match soak test, loading failures, focus changes and performance budgets pass on the presentation hardware
No game assets, engine or audio on default light/dark/embed paths; EN/ZH UI, cleanup and SEO remain intact
Optional cosmetic and menu details identified in the approved reference checklist
